name: CPU Usage %
description: process_cpu_seconds_total, by broker instance, 2-minute timeshift delta * 100.
programText:
raw = data('process_cpu_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker')).sum(by=['service.instance.id'])
(((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120) * 100).publish(label='CPU Usage %')
